facts.fact: ASIN's July 2026 legal note treats Benin's interoperability framework as in place, setting registration, technical and contractual conditions for connecting to the Xroad-BJ exchange platform, with the Comité national d'interopérabilité supervising; the note's date is the published date, 2026-07-28, no event date being given.

systems.owner: ASIN (management and governance); supervised by the Comité national d'interopérabilité
systems.tiers: public administrations and authorised actors; private bodies with adhesion convention and APDP authorisation

facts.fact: Benin's Cadre d'interopérabilité, published by ASIN, is instituted by décret n° 2020-209 of 18 March 2020 and sets four levels (juridical, organisational, semantic, technical) and five common infrastructure components; the document carries no publication date, so 2020-03-18 is the instituting decree's date.

systems.tiers: public and private administrations providing a public service

facts.fact: ASIN held a sectoral consultation workshop in Cotonou on the draft Politique d'architecture des systèmes d'information de l'État (PASI), which sets organising principles, technical rules and standards to make public information systems interoperable, before final versions go to the Ministry of Digital Affairs.
